title: Ranked Delegate seats are appointed at the top two levels but won by delegated voting power at Level 3
content:
The Ranked Delegate tiers use two different selection mechanisms. Levels 1 and 2 are filled by direct governance choice — "in the short term, the Level 1 Ranked Delegates are selected directly by Sky Governance" (A.1.6.4.1.1.3), with the same language for Level 2. Level 3 is purely mechanical: "The Level 3 Ranked Delegates are the Aligned Delegates with the greatest delegated Voting Power who are not Level 1 Ranked Delegates or Level 2 Ranked Delegates" (A.1.6.4.1.3.3), where delegated Voting Power means "the cumulative SKY that has been delegated to an Aligned Delegate's Delegate Contract."

The split gives the system two independent sources of legitimacy. Appointed seats let governance fund delegates for judgment or contribution that delegation volume does not capture; formula seats guarantee that whoever the market of SKY holders actually trusts most receives budget without needing anyone's approval. Neither mechanism can fully capture the ranked cohort.

The formula tier is also self-adjusting under enforcement. Both budget-contingency provisions (A.1.6.4.3.1, A.1.6.4.3.2) specify that when a Level 3 delegate falls below the participation floor, "their RD rank, and the budget eligibility associated with that rank, is transferred to the next highest-ranking AD, as determined by total amount of SKY delegated." There is a standing queue, so removal is costless — no seat sits empty and no appointment process is triggered.

A.1.6.4.4.1 confirms how live this is: the Core Facilitator must calculate "the Aligned Delegates ranked as Level 3 Ranked Delegates on a **daily** basis." The phrase "in the short term" attached to the appointed tiers signals both are provisional, with the direction of travel presumably toward mechanism over appointment.
description: A.1.6.4.1.1.3 and .2.3 have Sky Governance pick Levels 1-2 'in the short term', while A.1.6.4.1.3.3 awards Level 3 automatically to the highest-delegated ADs not already ranked.
